FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Performance Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A handful of changes made in the aim of improving performance. Perf was generally better than old Empire, but there were still some things to improve, so here we are. Hopefully nothing breaks!

patchNoteLines.li: Add more tick guards for sensitive code paths, and remove some redundant code

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Critical Fix for adding Empire mid-save
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a crash when trying to add Empire mid-save. In this circumstance, Empire attempted to initialize the XenotypeFilter in the FactionFC.FinalizeInit function. As part of initializing the filter, Empire attempts to load all custom xenotypes through CustomXenotypesForReading. That calls CheckVersionAndLoad, which in turn calls InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly. Fun fact: if the Scribe mode is *not* Inactive, then InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly panics and force stops the scribe process. And guess what Empire's custom xenotype loading does? That's right: it calls InitLoadingMetaHeaderOnly when the Scribe mode is not Inactive. Thus, loading stops, and everything breaks. Fun.\n\nThis issue does not affect new saves.

patchNoteLines.li: Change the xenotype filter to be initialized on the first tick instead of during loading
